node.title: Re: 74HC165 serial register reading with perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How is this IC connected to the system? If you're working on a Raspberry Pi, you might want to look at [stevieb]'s [cpan://RPi::] series of modules, which includes [mod://RPi::SPI], [mod://RPi::Serial], and [mod://RPi::WiringPi].

Update: Fixed missing links.
